content.hebrew: אָמוֹן הָיְתָה תּוֹרָה אֵֽצֶל נוֹרָא וְאָיוֹם
content.transliteration: Amon hayta tora etsel nora ve’ayom
content.english: The Torah was nurtured in the bosom of the awesome, formidable One,

content.hebrew: מְשַׂחֶֽקֶת לְפָנָיו בְּכָל־יוֹם.
content.english: Playing in front of Him every day.

content.hebrew: אֹמֶֽרֶת: שַׁעֲשׁוּעַי לִבְנֵי אָדָם פִּדְיוֹם –
content.english: She says: “My delights are a redemption for people—

content.hebrew: קהל: וָאֶהְיֶה שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים יוֹם יוֹם."     (משלי ח:ל)
content.english: Cong. And I was a delight every single day.”  (Prov. 8:30)

content.hebrew: הנֵּה חֻקַּת פָּרָה אֲדֻמָּה – בָּא דְבָרָהּ
content.transliteration: Hinnē ḥuḳḳat para adumma – ba devarah
content.english: Behold, the statute of the Red Cow—its purpose is

content.hebrew: לְטַהֵר טְמֵאֵי נֶֽפֶשׁ; נִשְׂרֶֽפֶת עִם עוֹרָהּ.
content.english: To purify those rendered impure by the dead; it is burned along with its hide.

content.hebrew: נְתוּנָה לִסְגַן כֹּהֲנִים עַד גָּמְרָהּ.
content.english: It is given to the deputy priest, until he has completed it[s ritual].

content.hebrew: קהל: אָז רָאָהּ וַיְסַפְּרָהּ הֱכִינָהּ וְגַם חֲקָרָהּ.   (איוב כח:כז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Az ra’ah vaysapperah hekhinah veḡam ḥaḳarah.
content.english: Cong. Then He saw it and took account of it; prepared it and investigated it. (Job 28:27)

content.hebrew: רָם סוֹדָהּ, כִּי מְטַמְּאָה וּמְטַהֶֽרֶת;
content.english: Its mystery is sublime, for it renders impure and pure;

content.hebrew: מֵעֵין כָּל־שֵֽׂכֶל יְדִיעָתָהּ נִסְתֶּֽרֶת.
content.english: Knowledge of it is concealed from the grasp of every intellect.

content.hebrew: שְׁלִישִׁי וּשְׁבִיעִי לְהַזָּאָה מְסֻדֶּֽרֶת,
content.english: [Its law] is set up such that the third and seventh days are for sprinkling,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהָיְתָה לַעֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁמֶֽרֶת.   (במדבר יט:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehayta la‘adat benē Yisra’el lemishmeret.
content.english: Cong. And it shall be for the community of the Israelites for keeping. (Num. 19:9)

content.hebrew: נִצְמְדוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וַיָּרִֽיבוּ אֶת רֹעָם וְצִירָם,
content.transliteration: Nitsmedu Yisra’el, vayyarivu et ro‘am vetsiram,
content.english: The Israelites were yoked, and they quarreled with their shepherd and emissary,
content.comments: Shepherd and emissary. God and Moses.

content.hebrew: כִּי צָמְאוּ הֵם וּבְעִירָם.
content.english: For they and their animals were thirsty.

content.hebrew: הִבְדִּֽילוּ בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין כַּוָּנַת חֶזְיוֹנָם, בְּדַבְּרָם.
content.transliteration: Hivdilu beno uven kavvanat ḥezyonam, bedabberam.
content.english: They made a separation between Him and the intention of their vision, when they spoke.

content.hebrew: קהל: וַיַּקְצִֽיפוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּֽרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם. (תהלים קו:לב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vayyaḳtsifu ‘al mē meriva, vayyera‘ leMoshē ba‘avuram.
content.english: Cong. And it went badly for Moses on their account.  (Ps. 106:32)

content.hebrew: הוֹסִֽיפוּ עוֹד פָּנִים לְגַלֵּה,
content.english: [The people] went on to reveal [their] face,

content.hebrew: וְשֻׁלְּחוּ בָם נְחָשִׁים, עַם רַב לְכַלֵּה.
content.english: And serpents were released against them, to wipe out the populous nation.

content.hebrew: וּפִלֵּל מֹשֶׁה, וּנְחַשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת לְנֵס הוֹדִיעוֹ עֲמֻקּוֹת מְגַלֵּה,
content.transliteration: Ufillel Moshē, unḥash neḥoshet lenes hodi‘o ‘amuḳḳot meḡalleh,
content.english: Moses prayed, and the One who reveals hidden things informed him [to make] a bronze serpent as a signpost,

content.hebrew: קהל: לְהַפְלִיא אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה הַפְלֵא וָפֶֽלֶא.  (ישעיהו כט:יד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Lehafli et ha‘am hazzē haflē vafeleh.
content.english: Cong. To perform miracles for this nation, miracle upon miracle. (Isa. 29:14)

content.hebrew: הֻכָּה סִיחוֹן, וְנִשְׂגַּב יוי לְבַדּוֹ,
content.english: Siḥon was beaten, and Adonai alone was lofty,

content.hebrew: כִּי לְכָל־גּוֹי שְׂאֵת אֵל וּפַחְדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki khol goy se’et El ufaḥado.
content.english: For God’s terror and dread was upon every nation.

content.hebrew: נָתַן אַרְצָם לְנַחֲלָה, לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ,
content.english: He gave their land as an inheritance, to Israel His servant,

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ.      (תהלים קלו:כב)
content.english: Cong. For His mercy is eternal.    (Ps. 136:22)

content.hebrew: חזן: אַ֤ךְ ׀ ט֣וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפ֖וּנִי כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֖י בְּבֵית־יו֗י לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים: (תהלים כג:ו)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Akh tov vaḥesed yirdefuni kol yemē ḥayyai veshavti bevet Adonai le’orekh yamim:
content.english: Cantor: Only goodness and mercy will pursue me all my days, and I shall dwell in Adonai’s house for many long days. (Ps. 23:6)

content.hebrew: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ: (תהלים פה:י)
content.transliteration: Akh ḳarov lire’av yish‘o lishkon kavod be’artsenu:
content.english: Indeed, His rescue is close to those who fear Him, such that His Glory will dwell in our land. (Ps. 85:10)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ: (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.english: Cong.: Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
